# Security Policy — SeoKitBundle

Security policy for **SeoKitBundle** (`nowo-tech/seo-kit-bundle`).

## Supported Versions

Security fixes land on the latest minor; upgrade within the 1.x line to receive them.

| Version  | Supported          |
| -------- | ------------------ |
| 1.17.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.17   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately to **hectorfranco@nowo.tech**.

Do not open public GitHub issues for security-sensitive reports.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide a remediation timeline when applicable.

See also [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md) for integrator-facing guidance.
